texts: good. the generic parses as a fireable rule giving every sky-cat its own roosting, on the cliff-spires as a definite set, with "during the day" kept as the time of that roosting.
good. reads exactly as the blanket denial the sentence makes — no sky-cat enters the village — while the village itself stays on record as a real place rather than being swallowed by the denial.
good. "the Keepers" is kept as one named body doing the tolerating, and "sky-cats" stays the kind at large rather than particular animals, which is what the sentence says.
